name: ap-gain
effect: Modifies the amount of AP a character earns after a battle.

name: gil-gain
effect: Modifies the amount of gil earned after a battle.

name: buff-factor-str-based
effect: Modifies the buff-factor for attacks affected by defense. The buff-factor can be understood as a final multiplier in the defense calculation. A buff-factor of 0.9 means the final damage value is reduced by an additional 10%.

name: buff-factor-mag-based
effect: Modifies the buff-factor for attacks affected by magic defense. The buff-factor can be understood as a final multiplier in the defense calculation. A buff-factor of 0.9 means the final damage value is reduced by an additional 10%.

name: accuracy-percentage
effect: Modifies the chance of landing a hit before luck is considered.

name: final-hit-rate
effect: Modifies the chance of landing a hit after luck has been considered.

name: final-evasion-rate
effect: Modifies the chance of evading a hit after luck has been considered.

name: critical-hit-rate
effect: Modifies a unit's chance of landing a critical hit. A value of 255 means the unit is always landing critical hits.

name: critical-hit-defense
effect: Modifies a unit's chance of avoiding a critical hit.

name: items-healing
effect: Modifies the amount of healing an item does.

name: minimum-damage
effect: Modifies the minimum amount of damage a character can inflict.

name: damage-limit
effect: Modifies the maximum amount of damage a character can inflict.

name: hp-limit
effect: Modifies the maximum amount of HP a character can have.

name: current-hp
effect: Modifies a unit's current HP value.

name: mp-limit
effect: Modifies the maximum amount of MP a character can have.

name: mp-cost
effect: Modifies the MP-cost of a character's abilities.

name: overdrive-charge
effect: Modifies the charge-rate of the overdrive gauge.

name: overdrive-gauge
effect: Modifies the value of a unit's overdrive gauge. If it reaches 100, the unit can use its Overdrive.

name: physical-damage-dealt
effect: Modifies the amount of physical damage a unit is dealing.

name: physical-damage-taken
effect: Modifies the amount of physical damage a unit is taking.

name: magical-damage-dealt
effect: Modifies the amount of magical damage a unit is dealing.

name: magical-damage-taken
effect: Modifies the amount of magical damage a unit is taking.

name: special-damage-dealt
effect: Modifies the amount of special damage a unit is dealing.

name: special-damage-taken
effect: Modifies the amount of special damage a unit is taking.

name: preemptive-strike-chance
effect: Modifies the chance of getting a preemptive strike at the start of a battle.

name: ambush-chance
effect: Modifies the chance of getting ambushed at the start of a battle.

name: encounter-rate
effect: Modifies the rate of getting into a random encounter.

name: common-steal-rate
effect: Modifies a character's chance of stealing the common item.

name: rare-steal-rate
effect: Modifies a character's chance of stealing the rare item.

name: initial-counter-value
effect: Modifies a unit's initial counter value at the start of a battle.

name: tick-speed
effect: Modifies a unit's tick speed.
